versions.changelog:
- Introduced the "内容创作流水线" skill for managing end-to-end content workflows in teams.
- Workflow: Topic ideation (探风) → Editor review (墨白) → Draft writing (锦书) → Final editor review (墨白) → Markdown output.
- Includes strict quality control with limited review iterations at each stage.
- Supports flexible flow: users can skip ideation or start with a provided topic.
- Final output is a platform-agnostic Markdown draft, with publishing suggestions upon completion.
- Requires prior installation of the content-creation team skill.
